metadata.question: Did lake ice extent on Lake Winnipeg, Canada, decrease between May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about lake ice extent change on Lake Winnipeg between two specific dates in May 2021. This requires: 1. Strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 or Landsat imagery for ice detection - Focus on Lake Winnipeg area - Compare May 7, 2021 vs May 19, 2021 - Use NDSI (Normalized Difference Snow Index) or simple reflectance thresholds to detect ice 2. Data Collection: - Use Sentinel-2 MSI (higher resolution) or Landsat 8/9 - Filter by dates: May 7, 2021 and May 19, 2021 - Filter by Lake Winnipeg region 3. Ice Detection: - NDSI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) - good for snow/ice detection - Threshold around 0.4-0.6 for ice - Could also use simple reflectance (ice has high reflectance in visible bands) 4. Processing: - Mask clouds using QA bands - Calculate ice area for each date - Compare the two areas 5. Potential Issues: - Cloud cover in May could be problematic - Lake Winnipeg is large, so need appropriate scale - Need to validate pixel counts Let me implement this using Sentinel-2 with cloud masking and NDSI-based ice detection. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const lakeWinnipeg = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-98.5, 53.0], [-96.0, 53.0], [-96.0, 50.0], [-98.5, 50.0], [-98.5, 53.0]] ]); const date1 = '2021-05-07'; const date2 = '2021-05-19'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 with cloud masking function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function getIceArea(date) { const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(lakeWinnipeg) .filterDate(date, ee.Date(date).advance(1, 'day')) .map(maskS2clouds); const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) return {area: null, pixels: 0, images: 0}; const image = collection.mosaic(); // Calculate NDSI for ice detection: (B3 - B11) / (B3 + B11) const ndsi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI'); // Ice mask: NDSI > 0.4 (common threshold for snow/ice) const iceMask = ndsi.gt(0.4); // Calculate ice area in square meters const iceArea = iceMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()); // Get pixel count and total area const stats = iceArea.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: lakeWinnipeg, scale: 300, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const area = stats.get('NDSI').getInfo(); const pixelCount = iceMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: lakeWinnipeg, scale: 300, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDSI').getInfo(); return {area: area, pixels: pixelCount, images: size}; } // 3. Get ice areas for both dates const ice1 = getIceArea(date1); const ice2 = getIceArea(date2); // 4. Check for empty collections if (ice1.images === 0 || ice2.images === 0) { print(`${date1} Images: ${ice1.images}, ${date2} Images: ${ice2.images}`); print("C1"); return; } // 5. Check for no valid pixels if (ice1.pixels === 0 || ice2.pixels === 0) { print(`${date1} Pixels: ${ice1.pixels}, ${date2} Pixels: ${ice2.pixels}`); print("C2"); return; } // 6. Validate calculations if (ice1.area === null || ice2.area === null || isNaN(ice1.area) || isNaN(ice2.area)) { print("Calculation failed - null/NaN results"); print("C3"); return; } // 7. Print results and determine answer print(`${date1}: ${(ice1.area/1e6).toFixed(1)} km² (Pixels: ${ice1.pixels})`); print(`${date2}: ${(ice2.area/1e6).toFixed(1)} km² (Pixels: ${ice2.pixels})`); print(`Change: ${((ice2.area - ice1.area)/1e6).toFixed(1)} km²`); // 8. Final answer based on ice extent change if (ice2.area < ice1.area) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
